gloss: fall seven times, rise eight; perseverance

definitions.gloss: fall seven times, rise eight; perseverance through repeated failures
definitions.explanation: The spirit of never giving up despite repeated failures; getting back up one more time than you fall down.

examples.japanese: {七転八起|しちてんはっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: To persevere with the spirit of never giving up.

examples.japanese: {七転八起|しちてんはっき}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧、⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧な。
examples.english: Keep getting back up—don't give up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{七転八起|しちてんはっき}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: His life was truly one of persistent comebacks.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧):
⟦{七転|しちてん}→七転：noentry⟧ (seven tumbles) + ⟦{八起|はっき}→八起：noentry⟧ (eight rises)

ALTERNATE READING:
Also read as ⟦{七転び八起|ななころびやお}き→七転び八起き：06141_nanakorobiyaoki⟧ in a more colloquial style.

USAGE:
The logic is that if you fall seven times but get up eight times, you end up standing—symbolizing resilience and determination.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Often associated with ⟦{達磨|だるま}→達磨：06539_daruma⟧ (Daruma) dolls, which are designed to right themselves when knocked over.

- {七転八起|しちてんはっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: spirit of perseverance
- {七転八起|しちてんはっき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧: to persevere through setbacks
